tools.name: search_artworks
tools.description: Search the Artnap archive of public domain paintings, drawings, prints and posters from museum open access collections. Returns each work with title, artist, year, museum, license, a 2,500 px image address and its Artnap page.

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: One artwork by its Artnap id: title, artist, year, museum, license, the 2,500 px image, its Artnap page and the holding museum's own record.

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: Artists in the Artnap archive whose name matches the words given, with dates, number of works and their Artnap page.

tools.name: list_museums
tools.description: The museums and libraries whose open access collections Artnap brings together, with the number of works from each and their Artnap page.

tools.name: get_license_summary
tools.description: The license line for one artwork (public domain, CC0 or CC BY) and where to check it at the holding museum.
